devicedata.creator: DirectorLink
devicedata.name: DirectorLink · Android TV Notifications
devicedata.model: Google TV, Android TV and Fire TV pop-up notifications

event.name: Notification Shown
event.description: When NAME has shown a pop-up on the TV; LAST_NOTIFICATION is its text

event.name: Notification Failed
event.description: When a pop-up could not be shown on NAME's TV (off, not reachable, the app not running, or no answer); LAST_NOTIFICATION is its text

property.name: TV App
property.tooltip: The app on the TV that shows the pop-ups. Notifications for Android TV: from Google Play (Notifications for Fire TV from the Amazon Appstore). PiPup: installed from a computer with its script.

property.name: TV IP Address
property.tooltip: The TV's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50, or pick it in TVs Found. Give the TV a fixed address in the router.

property.name: TVs Found
property.tooltip: The TVs and casting devices that answered Find TVs (they answer while they are on), the ones where the app answers first. Pick one to fill in TV IP Address.

property.name: Doorbell
property.tooltip: Show DirectorLink's doorbell rings on this TV.

property.name: Camera Alerts
property.tooltip: Show DirectorLink's camera alerts (a person, a vehicle...) on this TV.

property.name: Doors and Gates
property.tooltip: Show DirectorLink's notifications that a door or gate opened on this TV.

property.name: Alarm
property.tooltip: Show DirectorLink's alarm notifications on this TV.

property.name: Other
property.tooltip: Show DirectorLink's other notifications on this TV.

property.name: Quiet Hours
property.tooltip: From-to, in the controller's local time, for example 22:00-07:00: no pop-ups on this TV then. Empty: none.

property.name: Pictures
property.tooltip: On: a notification's picture (who is at the door or the gate) shows in the pop-up. The TV fetches it from the address the notification gives.

property.name: Position
property.tooltip: Where on the screen the pop-up shows.

property.name: Seconds On Screen
property.tooltip: How long the pop-up stays on the screen.

property.name: Log Level
property.tooltip: Info writes one line for every pop-up. Debug and Trace show every check and every request to the TV.

command.name: SHOW_NOTIFICATION
command.description: Show a pop-up on NAME's TV: PARAM1, PARAM2
